scope: One static represented IL/OZ word on the existing maintained contact; no trajectory or parameter search
question: Which operator effects survive immediate selected-law pressure refresh, and does the represented IL reset retain the proved joint identity?

preparation.preservation: Preserve complete persistent source state, instance event state and adjacency order; use the shared SDK graph-data copier plus the declared study adapter, omitting only rebuildable TNFR cache payloads and retaining their inventory.

law.name: conservative_sine_support_exchange
law.S_i: Sum sin(theta_j-theta_i) over unique bare neighbors
law.support: Actual 45 undirected edges, actual held conductances, bare degrees including zero-conductance support
law.capacity: Held represented source values; 1/2 on targets 0 and 1, one elsewhere
law.clock: Original structural clock, no elapsed interval
law.forcing: GAMMA none; no input or loss
law.reference: Common-aligned doubled C5 twist, exact angle 2*pi/5

execution.whole_word_admission: ValidatedSequence with core compatibility and truthful initial_epi_nonzero=True
execution.IL_phase_coefficient: binary64 representation of 0.3, existing dispatcher default
execution.IL_pressure_factor: Existing resolved default IL_dnfr_factor; record exact represented value
execution.OZ_pressure_factor: Existing resolved default OZ_dnfr_factor; record exact represented value
execution.OZ_PHASE_THRESHOLD: Existing resolved default; record exact represented value
execution.OZ_near_zero_cutoff: Existing fixed binary64 1e-9, equality selects seed branch
execution.refresh_writer: Re-admit primitives with bound_relational_sine_support_exchange; admit every pressure interval midpoint with shared represented-real admission before any set_dnfr write
execution.callback_guard: Compare full persistent graph/node/edge state before and after each refresh, permitting only pressure aliases and _dnfrmax/_dnfrmax_node; independently check the maximum and its witness

arithmetic.runtime: Python binary64, existing registered kernels and reduction order
arithmetic.independent_oracle: mpmath clone with 100 decimal digits, when a non-interval cross-check is used
arithmetic.unchanged_state_comparisons: Exact represented values; tolerance cannot establish equality
arithmetic.IL_lift: Nearest continuous phase displacement from the captured prestate; retain circular wrap and represented endpoint residual
arithmetic.IL_work_bridge_allowance: 14/70368744177664, from two degree-seven coordinates and individual phase residuals at most 2^-46
arithmetic.ideal_IL_coefficient: Exact rational value of the represented binary64 0.3; not exact 3/10
arithmetic.propagation: Retain each consumed candidate, primitive admission and floating product against rational/interval expectation, including candidates suppressed by the existing threshold
arithmetic.underflow: Reject a nonzero midpoint lost on materialization; record any nonzero consumed propagation product rounded to zero as an arithmetic failure
arithmetic.budget: One declared preparation and two stages; no trajectory, coefficient sweep, source retuning or accuracy escalation

prospective_predictions.claim: The prepared full word is admitted without replacement or grammar padding.
prospective_predictions.failure: Retain actual grammar/live rejection as a result; do not change the preparation to bypass it.

prospective_predictions.claim: IL changes target phases and selected-law form rates, preserves form/support/capacity, and has strictly negative phase-storage work while retaining Z and the storage barrier.
prospective_predictions.basis: The conditional simultaneous-IL theorem with the shared-edge correction; strictness requires a resolved nonzero displacement.
prospective_predictions.checks: Rebuild H, Z, local resultants, actual adjacent-edge work and represented phase residuals from captured state. Do not infer exact-real membership from an operator label.

prospective_predictions.claim: OZ changes raw stored pressure and execution context, preserves the continuous state exactly, and its immediate selected-law refresh restores exactly the post-IL pressure and both complete rate rows.
prospective_predictions.basis: Projection equivalence under this algebraic pressure law, conditional on no later context-consuming intervention.
prospective_predictions.checks: Separate raw local proposal, neighbor contributions, final accumulated pressure, refreshed pressure, full state, grammar context and stage records.

prospective_predictions.claim: The inherited glyph history does not supply a measured three-sample EPI acceleration.
prospective_predictions.checks: Retain typed availability, source and units; compatibility telemetry zero is not a measured zero or a bifurcation result.

classification_rules.operator_admission: accepted, grammar_rejected or live_state_rejected, with original diagnostic
classification_rules.numerics: within frozen residual budget, unsupported/unresolved enclosure, or arithmetic failure
classification_rules.ideal_OZ_branch: Classify only when the ideal pressure enclosure resolves the fixed cutoff; otherwise abstain while retaining the executed represented branch
classification_rules.propagation: Zero admitted neighbor increments is an allowed outcome; do not lower the policy threshold to manufacture propagation
classification_rules.strict_work: Requires an interval wholly below zero; zero-containing work is inconclusive for strictness
classification_rules.retention: Requires actual represented endpoint identity and strict storage margin; no trajectory is inferred
classification_rules.scope: Finite implemented evidence plus existing conditional proofs; no autonomous occurrence, selected pressure memory, scalar collective closure or physical identification

provenance.freeze_boundary: Bind this protocol, evaluator and source snapshot before any new maintained-contact IL/OZ response
provenance.retention: Preserve attempts, source archive, raw response, analysis and checks; corrective evidence must not overwrite a previous evaluated record
provenance.byte_associations: Hashes identify retained bytes; they are not provenance authentication

correction.reason: Generic deepcopy encountered an RLock in runtime cache before any IL/OZ action or initial refresh.
correction.changed_mechanism: Use tnfr.sdk._state.copy_graph_state with explicit graph-instance-state and neighbor-order retention; preserve source and declare cache rebuilding.
